title: Pokémon Unbound
sources: The ROM itself (Unbound v2.1.1.1, FireRed base): region map section names, trainer names, teams and levels, species and evolution methods, map hidden items, read on the PC with throwaway tools
unboundwiki.com: legendary Pokémon, missions, raid dens, evolution items, mining items
gamebrew.org: Pokemon Unbound (GBA): features and change log (v2.1.1.1)

milestones.name: Escape the Shadow Base
milestones.tips: The game opens in a Shadow warehouse: you and the rival take on a grunt's Inkay and Skorupi together in a double battle, then slip out through a secret tunnel to Route 1.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 1

milestones.name: Rival: first battle
milestones.tips: Professor Log offers Beldum, Gible or Larvitar (Lv 10); the rival takes one of the other two and battles you on the spot.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 1

milestones.name: Recover the stolen package
milestones.tips: On the north side of Frozen Heights a grunt left behind after Marlon's group takes Articuno keeps the package; his lone Snorunt (Lv 9) is easy work.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 1

milestones.name: Alolan Sandslash in Icicle Cave
milestones.tips: A Lv 12 Alolan Sandslash waits in its lair off Icicle Cave 4F (the Sandslash thief mission); it cannot be caught. Fire, Fighting and Steel moves do well.
milestones.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 2

milestones.name: Rival: Icicle Cave
milestones.tips: On 2F the rival leads Swinub (Lv 12) and their starter (Lv 13). Heal at the Chansey by the 3F ladder first; he hands over Safety Goggles afterwards.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 2

milestones.name: Gym 1: Mirskle
milestones.badge_note: Leaf Badge and TM86 Grass Knot; the gym guide adds a Grass Gem.
milestones.tips: A Grass-type double battle (Vanilla: Gloom and Flabébé; harder modes add Weedle and Comfey). The gym is filled with fog: bring a Defog user such as Edmund's Ducklett, plus Litleo from the Route 2 challenge.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 4

milestones.name: Shadow Admin Marlon: Cinder Volcano
milestones.tips: A Shadow Battle on 1F West alongside Jax, who lends Staravia, Magnemite and Golett; Marlon and a grunt field Duskull, Sableye and Cacnea. A Chansey by the 2F West ladder heals you first.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 5

milestones.name: Black Emboar: Boss James
milestones.tips: Clear goons A-D on the KBT Expressway, then James (Koffing, Salandit, Alolan Grimer, Pignite) waits north of the mining area. He gives you the Motorcycle.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7

milestones.name: Gym 2: Véga
milestones.tips: Dark types (Vanilla: Liepard, Sneasel, Absol). The gym is dark: beating trainers widens your view, and the dark energy hurts anything that is not Dark or Ghost. Fighting, Bug and Fairy moves win.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7

milestones.name: Shadow Admin Ivory: Cinder Volcano
milestones.tips: Ivory has just captured Moltres; her Misdreavus and Kadabra (Vanilla) fall to Dark moves.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7

milestones.name: Shadow Boss Zeph: Cinder Volcano
milestones.tips: Zeph, the Shadow leader, sends out a single Houndoom (Lv 24 in Vanilla). Water, Ground, Rock and Fighting moves handle it. Afterwards a Hiker in the tunnel south of Crater Town gives HM01 Cut.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7

milestones.name: Rival: Frost Mountain
milestones.tips: On 1F: Trumbeak, Swinub and the rival's starter in its middle stage (Lv 26). Fire, Fighting and Steel moves cover most of it.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 9

milestones.name: Gym 3: Alice
milestones.badge_note: Wings Badge and TM40 Aerial Ace; Alice then smashes the KBT Expressway barrier and gives HM06 Rock Smash.
milestones.tips: Flying types (Vanilla: Doduo, Gliscor, Minior) behind a fan maze. Gliscor is Ground/Flying, so Ice moves beat it where Electric fails. Get the Ice Stone and Crabominable in Frozen Forest first.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 10

milestones.name: Ace Trainer Alexa (Fire Gem)
milestones.tips: Optional: with Rock Smash, Alexa waits on Cinder Volcano 2F West (Breloom, Gardevoir, Magmar, Sealeo, Florges) and gives a Fire Gem.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 10

milestones.name: Visiting Leader Candice (optional)
milestones.tips: Upstairs in a house on Blizzard City's middle ring, Sinnoh's Candice battles once a day with Sneasel, Piloswine, Glaceon and Froslass and switches often; she gives an Ice Gem each win.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 9

milestones.name: Terror Granbull: Boss Gruff
milestones.tips: After the four Snubbull goons on Routes 9-10, Gruff (Probopass, Ariados, Crawdaunt, Granbull) waits north of the bridge on Route 10; the policeman gives TM106 Smart Strike.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 12

milestones.name: Shadow Admin Ivory: Route 9
milestones.tips: Reach Route 9 through Tehl Town's secret passage, beat the occupying grunts, then Ivory and a grunt in her house (Incineroar, Alakazam, Misdreavus with Gourgeist and Alolan Raticate). Jax offers to tag along; declining keeps your full team.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 13

milestones.name: Gym 4: Mel
milestones.badge_note: Fall Badge, TM42 Facade and HM02 Fly; Strength works from now on.
milestones.tips: Normal types under Inverse Battle rules, so type matchups flip: leave Fighting types out. Vanilla: Helioptile, Miltank, Lopunny; the walkthrough suggests Lv 35+ and strong moves of many types.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 14

milestones.name: Mega Trainer Yale (Cameruptite)
milestones.tips: Optional, with Strength: Yale on Cinder Volcano 3F West ends with a Mega Camerupt and hands over the Cameruptite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 14

milestones.name: Shadow grunts on Thundercap Mt.
milestones.tips: Grunts block 1F-2F (A: Inkay, Trevenant, Skorupi). On 5F the last grunt carries the Barrier Key that switches off the electric fences. A nurse on 3F heals for free.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 15

milestones.name: Shadow Admin Marlon: Thundercap summit
milestones.tips: Marlon uses the Zapdos he caught (Lv 35) with Cacturne and Krookodile in Vanilla. Ice and Rock moves cover Zapdos; Water and Grass handle Krookodile.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 15

milestones.name: Successor Maxima: Tarmigan Mansion
milestones.tips: In the mansion's basement Maxima uses Wigglytuff, Delphox, Empoleon and Mega Altaria (Vanilla). Winning unlocks Mega Evolution: she gives the Mega Keystone and Altarianite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 16

milestones.name: Rival: Route 12
milestones.tips: Toucannon, Vaporeon, Piloswine and the starter's middle stage. Professor Log gives HM03 Surf afterwards (usable after the Dehara badge).
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 17

milestones.name: Ruins of Void: grunt and the portal challenge
milestones.tips: Talk to Jax at the Cloud Game Corner to go on. Claydol guards B2F, and a portal challenge sends Claydol, Raikou, Entei and Suicune at you with no break (level-scaled). A grunt on 1F has Cofagrigus and Sableye.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 18

milestones.name: Agent Véga and the Light of Ruin
milestones.tips: In Cinder Volcano's depths Véga (Liepard, Honchkrow, Mega Absol) and a Light of Ruin grunt take on you and Marlon; you pick three Pokémon. Heal before B2F: Marlon then fights Primal Groudon for you.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 19

milestones.name: Shadow Boss Zeph: Shadow Base
milestones.tips: Wear Marlon's uniform and collect Key Cards 1-3 to reach B3F. Zeph: Mightyena, Exploud, Decidueye and Mega Gengar (Vanilla). Behind a level-2 door is your starter's Mega Stone; Houndoomite is on B3F.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 19

milestones.name: Gym 5: Galavan
milestones.badge_note: Battery Badge and TM92 Volt Switch; Surf can now be used.
milestones.tips: Electric/Steel double battle (Vanilla: Alolan Golem, Eelektross, Magneton, Mega Manectric). The gym's magnetism makes everything levitate, so Ground moves miss: bring Fire (Mega Camerupt) and Fighting moves.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 20

milestones.name: Ocean Master Osean
milestones.tips: Optional: beat every trainer on Routes 13 and 14 and Osean appears in Route 13's south-east (Pelipper, Samurott, Ludicolo, Kingdra, Mega Gyarados); he gives the Gyaradosite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 21

milestones.name: Light of Ruin leader Aklove: Vivill Warehouse
milestones.tips: Collect the password letters (AKLOVE) from the warehouse grunts to reach the Command Center. Aklove: Roserade, Primarina and Hoopa Unbound (Vanilla). The Go-Goggles from Dehara's hiker get you across the desert.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 25

milestones.name: Giratina in the Distortion World
milestones.tips: After Aklove you are sent to the Distortion World; solve its boulder and platform puzzles and defeat Giratina (level-scaled) to open the portal home, which comes out in Rift Cave.
milestones.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 25

milestones.name: Fighting Challenge: Vivian and Mathis
milestones.tips: Optional: beat every other trainer on Routes 2 and 15, then the pair on Route 2's island (Hitmonlee, Hawlucha, two Mega Lopunny) give the Lopunnite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 26

milestones.name: Black Ferrothorn: Rory
milestones.tips: Helping the Black Emboar in Antisis City: after the port smuggling run (after 8 PM), Rory and Chad fight on the eastern bridge (Weezing, Muk, Ferroseed or Ferrothorn, Krokorok).
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 27

milestones.name: Black Ferrothorn: Boss Barbs
milestones.tips: Through the sewers (Flash and Surf) to Ferrothorn Turf's top floor; Barbs uses Alolan Muk, Honchkrow, Ferrothorn and Mega Heracross. James leaves the Heracronite outside.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 28

milestones.name: Gym 6: Big Mo
milestones.badge_note: Ring Badge and TM60 Drain Punch; Rock Climb can now be used.
milestones.tips: First the Ring Challenge: three one-Pokémon fights, no Flying, Psychic or Fairy moves. Then Fighting types (Vanilla: Mienshao, Pangoro, Hariyama, Mega Lucario); a sturdy Pokémon with strong neutral moves helps.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 29

milestones.name: Skiers Club: Mega Trainer Lily
milestones.tips: Optional: the Skiers Club island off Icicle Cave 1F (north ice puzzle). Lily ends with Mega Glalie; decline membership to get the Glalitite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 29

milestones.name: Mountain Master Aloysius
milestones.tips: Optional: beat every other trainer on Thundercap's Antisis side and Aloysius appears on 2F (Politoed, Blissey, Braviary, Reuniclus, Mega Ampharos); he gives the Ampharosite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 30

milestones.name: Sky Master Almuth
milestones.tips: Optional Sky Battle (Flying types only) south-west of the broken Route 17 bridge: Noctowl, Tropius, Wash Rotom, Hawlucha, Mega Pidgeot. Bring three fliers; the prize is the Pidgeotite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 31

milestones.name: Seaport warehouses: the stolen Electivire
milestones.tips: The West Warehouse only lets in Ice- or Fairy-type teams (double battles with burglars). In the East Warehouse beat Electivire, then a Dynamax Electivire, then the Science Society scientist (Rotom, Magnezone, Manectric, Vikavolt).
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 32

milestones.name: Gym 7: Tessy
milestones.tips: Each Pokémon takes the types of its first two moves in this gym (yours too), so reorder moves first. Vanilla: Toxapex, Seismitoad, Armaldo, Mega Gyarados. Waves wash you back if you are still surfing.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 33

milestones.name: Rival: Crystal Peak
milestones.tips: At the entrance: Toucannon, Vaporeon, Mamoswine, Aggron or Haxorus, and the starter's Mega final form (Lv 58). Afterwards you choose three Pokémon for the double battles beside the rival.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Reshiram and Zekrom
milestones.tips: On 3F you and the rival face Reshiram and Zekrom together (level-scaled). An Alolan Ninetales with Icium Z can knock Zekrom out at once.
milestones.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Light of Ruin Admin Ivory: Crystal Peak
milestones.tips: After her son, Ivory: Mismagius, Incineroar, Mandibuzz and Mega Alakazam (Vanilla). The 4F sandstorm hurts all but Rock, Steel and Ground types.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Hoopa Unbound and Mega Rayquaza
milestones.tips: On the summit Hoopa Unbound and Mega Rayquaza fight as a pair (level-scaled). Hoopa Confined (Lv 60) is yours afterwards, with the Prison Bottle to switch its forms.
milestones.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Aklove: Crystal Peak summit
milestones.tips: A double battle by the Ultimate Weapon controls: Klefki, Primarina, Raichu, Gardevoir, Roserade (Vanilla).
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Marlon: Crystal Peak summit
milestones.tips: After Aklove comes a double battle with Marlon (Krookodile, Cacturne, Mega Sharpedo, Dusknoir in Vanilla), the rival at your side. Show Hoopa to the Epidimy elders for a Master Ball.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

milestones.name: Gym 8: Benjamin
milestones.badge_note: Time Badge and TM49 Leech Fang; the League opens.
milestones.tips: Bug types that devolve instead of fainting (yours do too, until the battle ends). Vanilla: Araquanid, Mega Scizor, Drapion, Butterfree. Room puzzle order: Crystal Peak, Thundercap, Cinder Volcano, Icicle Cave.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 36

milestones.name: Route Master Reena
milestones.tips: Optional: after every other Route 18 trainer, Reena (Tsareena, Rapidash, Milotic, Dragonite, Mega Sableye) gives the Sablenite.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 37

milestones.name: Victory Road: Portia and Sterling
milestones.tips: The last trainers before the League, a double battle on the Upper Ascent: Typhlosion, Meganium, Mega Charizard Y, Mega Venusaur. A psychic on 4F skips the ice puzzle for P45,000.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 38

milestones.name: Elite Four: Moleman
milestones.tips: Ground types in a double battle (Vanilla: Excadrill, Flygon, Gliscor, Quagsire). Ice moves hit three of them hard. The Elite Four can be taken in any order; you can't return to the lobby.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39

milestones.name: Elite Four: Elias
milestones.tips: Ghost types, single battle (Vanilla: Mimikyu, Aegislash, Chandelure, Mega Banette). Dark and Ghost moves; mind Mimikyu's Disguise.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39

milestones.name: Elite Four: Arabella
milestones.tips: Fairy types, single battle (Vanilla: Ribombee, Sylveon, Azumarill, Mega Mawile). Poison and Steel moves; Fire or Ground for Mawile.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39

milestones.name: Elite Four: Penny
milestones.tips: Dragons in a double battle (Vanilla: Goodra, Tyrantrum, Kommo-o, Mega Sceptile). Fairy and Ice moves.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39

milestones.name: Champion: Jax
milestones.tips: Your old ally is the Champion, in a double battle: Golurk, Staraptor, Magnezone, Pyroar, Gastrodon, Mega Salamence (Vanilla). Bring Revives and Full Restores.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39

milestones.name: Post-game: Aklove in the Ruins of Void depths
milestones.tips: Buy the ADM from Captain Davy (P250,000), dive at the Ruins of Void, slip past the Claydol maze and a Dynamax Claydol, then a double battle beside Jax's Pokémon: Klefki, Roserade, Togekiss, Raichu, Primarina, Mega Gardevoir.
milestones.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 40

steps.title: Choose a pseudo-legendary starter
steps.text: Professor Log offers Beldum, Gible or Larvitar at Lv 10; each has a Mega Stone later in the Shadow Base. Turn on the real-time clock; Vanilla difficulty is the walkthrough's pick for a first run.

steps.title: Egg and missions in Bellin Town
steps.text: An old man south of the Sandslash house gives an Egg (Stunky, Skorupi or Glameow). Your mom gives the Mission Log for the Cube, the game's bag.

steps.title: Route 2 Challenge Road
steps.text: Beat every trainer on Route 2 for the Challenge Giver's Litleo (Lv 10), handy against Mirskle. A Braille Converter in Icicle Cave's Tablet Cavern starts the tablet mission.

steps.title: A Defog user for the first gym
steps.text: Edmund in Dresco Town trades a Lv 13 Ducklett that knows Defog for an Alolan Sandshrew from Icicle Cave 4F; Defog clears the gym's harmful fog. The Trainer House trainers can be rebattled for experience.

steps.title: Start the Zygarde Cell hunt
steps.text: The scientists Zygfried and Zygardia in Dresco Town give a Super Cube part that detects Zygarde Cells; 100 of them earn a Power Construct Zygarde.

steps.title: Unova starter on Route 5
steps.text: In the house west of the Day Care pick Snivy, Tepig or Oshawott; the other two can be had at 4 and 7 badges. Start the Route 5 walking mission (150,000 steps) early.

steps.title: Cut and the mining game
steps.text: After Véga, a Hiker in the tunnel south of Crater Town gives HM01 Cut. HMs work from any party member that could learn them. The KBT Expressway mining game costs P1000 a try.

steps.title: Old Rod on Route 7
steps.text: The fisherman in his house on Route 7 gives the Old Rod. A Chansey at the Route 6 cave exit heals for free.

steps.title: Blizzard City errands
steps.text: Get the VS Seeker upstairs in the Berry house, HM06 Rock Smash's hiker east of the gym, and an Eviolite from the Pokémon Center breeder. With 15 Pokémon caught your Pokédex gets the DexNav upgrade.

steps.title: Frozen Forest
steps.text: Solve the ice puzzle, beat Burglar Jett to return a woman's Alolan Ninetales (she gives an Alolan Vulpix Egg), then catch the Lv 32 Crabominable, your only chance.

steps.title: Fallshore City's services
steps.text: Mission HQ (Trainer Catalogue after 5 missions), the Evolution House (Link Stone), the Inverse Battle House and the market. The old lady in the left house gives a Togepi Egg.

steps.title: HM04 Strength in Epidimy
steps.text: The Black Belt in Epidimy Town gives HM04 Strength (usable after Mel's badge); the fisherman next to the old couple upgrades you to the Good Rod.

steps.title: Dowsing Machine in Tehl Town
steps.text: With 30 Pokémon caught, the researcher's house in Tehl Town gives the Dowsing Machine for hidden items.

steps.title: Through Tarmigan Mansion
steps.text: Three hidden statue switches open the mansion; two Chansey heal inside (1F stairs, 3F top room). The garden behind Maxima has a Raid Den.

steps.title: Dehara City
steps.text: The Game Corner man gives the Coin Case; the Dept. Store sells stones (3F) and TMs (4F). A trainer in the top-right house gives a Lv 30 Turtwig (Chimchar and Piplup at 6 and 8 badges).

steps.title: Surf backtracking
steps.text: With Galavan's badge Surf opens TM13 Ice Beam in Icicle Cave, TM35 Flamethrower in Cinder Volcano, TM30 Shadow Ball on Route 9 and the Steelixite in Fallshore City.

steps.title: Go-Goggles for the Great Desert
steps.text: After the Dehara gym, a hiker in Dehara's south-east house gives the Go-Goggles; the desert's sandstorm otherwise hurts all but Rock, Steel and Ground types. Smash desert rocks for fossils, revived in Gurun Town.

steps.title: Hiker Finn and the Lost Tunnel
steps.text: On Auburn Waterway, beat Hiker Finn and dig him out of the Lost Tunnel with a Dig user (Excadrill from the volcano depths); he gives TM28 Dig. The Lost Tunnel is pitch dark and Flash does not help.

steps.title: Devon Scope and Rock Climb
steps.text: A stranger on Route 16 (Big Mo in disguise) gives the Devon Scope for invisible Kecleon; a Worker on Route 17 gives HM08 Rock Climb, usable after the Ring Badge.
steps.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 26; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 29

steps.title: Seaport City
steps.text: The Docks fisherman gives the Super Rod; the woman north of the market gives Rowlet (Lv 45; Litten and Popplio at 7 and 8 badges). The Breeder's School rewards hatching Eggs.

steps.title: An Ice and Fairy team
steps.text: The West Warehouse admits only Ice or Fairy types: Alolan Ninetales, Sealeo, Piloswine and Jynx from Icy Hole are the walkthrough's picks. Heal between every fight; there is no way back past the boulder.

steps.title: Rotom in Polder Town
steps.text: Help the father of the TV-obsessed girl (brain scans of children in four towns, Dream Research Lab) for a Rotom; the Antisis warehouse changes its form.

steps.title: Protector of the Swamp
steps.text: After the badge, Tessy's mission in Cootes Bog: double battles with her against Terror Granbull goons, ending with a Dynamax Feraligatr. She gives TM120 Nature Power.

steps.title: Before the League
steps.text: At the Victory Road entrance Professor Log gives two shards of each colour for move tutors; the Camomons Battle House in Seaport City can be rebattled for experience.

steps.title: After the credits
steps.text: You wake in Frozen Heights: the Battle Frontier is open, and Hoopa has opened portals across Borrius (the Portal Purge mission). A letter at home points at Aklove.

secrets.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 map hidden items; unboundwiki.com walkthrough

secrets.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 map hidden items; unboundwiki.com walkthrough

secrets.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 map hidden items; unboundwiki.com walkthrough

secrets.text: Hidden in Icicle Cave: Ice Stone, Big Pearl, Blue Shard.
secrets.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 map hidden items; unboundwiki.com walkthrough

secrets.text: The old lady in Fallshore City's left-hand house gives a Togepi Egg; keep a party slot free.
Return the stolen Alolan Ninetales (Burglar Jett, Frozen Forest) for an Alolan Vulpix Egg.
Electivire's owner in Epidimy Town gives an Elekid Egg, Electirizer, Power Weight and Gold Bottle Cap once it is rescued.
A Black Emboar goon in Antisis City gives an Alolan Grimer Egg after the scientist mission.
Lv 10 Litleo from the Challenge Giver for beating all Route 2 trainers.
Lv 30 Turtwig in Dehara's top-right house; Chimchar and Piplup come at 6 and 8 badges.
Lv 45 Rowlet from the woman north of the Seaport market; Litten and Popplio at 7 and 8 badges.
The Polder Town fisherman gives a Feebas for 100 Pokémon caught by fishing (10 Dive Balls at 10, Heart Scales at 50).
Rotom from the father in Polder Town after curing his TV-obsessed daughter.
Hoopa Confined (Lv 60) joins you after the summit battle, with the Prison Bottle.
Win 3000 coins in one day at Cloud Burst for a Lv 35 Balloon Pikachu.
A Poké Ball by Vivill Woods' pond holds Foongus or Morelull (by Trainer ID); evolve it and trade in Vivill Town for the other line.
Cosmog sits in a bag on Route 12's west beach; on Difficult and harder it can only be taken after the Elite Four.
Saige in Epidimy Town trades a Hitmontop (holding Protect Pads) for a Lickitung from Route 5.
Tim in Tarmigan Town trades a Pachirisu (holding Old Gateau) for a Manectric.
Alicia in Blizzard City trades an Electrode holding an Amulet Coin for an Onix from Frost Mountain.
Edmund trades a Defog Ducklett (Lv 13) for an Alolan Sandshrew.
Lv 32 Crabominable after Burglar Jett; the only one in the game.
A catchable Lv 50 Mimikyu waits at a dead end in the West Warehouse's first passage.
Wild Chansey heal your party in caves and routes (Icicle Cave 3F, Cinder Volcano 2F West, Route 9); a Porygon gives PC access.
Show Hoopa to the old couple in Epidimy Town for a Master Ball.
secrets.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 12; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

secrets.text: Smashed desert rocks sometimes drop fossils; the Gurun Town scientist revives them (Tyrunt, Amaura, Archen, Kabuto and more).
20 missions done: the Mission HQ ranger gives Type: Null; 65 earn a Shiny Charm.
An Evolution Stone Man on an island in Thundercap's 3F lake (Antisis side) gives a random stone once a day.
Groudon returns to Cinder Volcano B2F after the story once you have the Red Orb.
Kyurem lives in Kyurem's Cave in Victory Road's snow area.
Darkrai on Newmoon Island, reached from Tarmigan Town.
Cresselia on Fullmoon Island (The Endless Nightmare mission).
Regirock inside the Desert Ruins in the Great Desert.
Dialga in the Cave of Being (Guardians of the Lake mission).
Palkia in Rift Cave (A Rift in Space mission).
Shaymin in the northern restricted part of Flower Paradise.
Heatran appears on Cinder Volcano 1F once you have the Magma Stone (Seaport Breeder's School, 100 Eggs hatched).
secrets.source: unboundwiki.com legendary Pokémon; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 31

secrets.text: All 100 Zygarde Cells earn Zygarde from the Dresco Town scientists.
Jirachi inside the locked house in Crater Town; with it in your party, Deoxys waits in a part of Route 13.

notes.title: Unbound 2.1.1.1
notes.text: Skeli's FireRed hack (built on the CFRU engine) set in the Borrius region, with species to Gen VII (Gen VIII forms with the activation) and Gen VIII battle mechanics. The ROM's trainer data holds a separate team per difficulty.
notes.source: gamebrew.org: Pokemon Unbound; ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table

notes.title: Difficulty modes
notes.text: Vanilla, Difficult, Expert and Insane. Leaders, admins and the Elite Four have a different team in each; the level caps in this guide are the Vanilla teams' top levels, and the foe lists include the harder teams' levels. Puzzles have their own difficulty too.
notes.source: gamebrew.org changelog; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 1; ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 trainer table

notes.title: Mega Evolution
notes.text: Mega Evolution unlocks when Successor Maxima gives the Mega Keystone in Tarmigan Mansion. Many Mega Stones come from optional Mega Trainers (Yale, Osean, Lily, Aloysius, Almuth, Reena).

notes.title: Z-Moves
notes.text: Z-Crystals are found around Borrius: Icium Z from an old man in Seaport City, Pikanium Z in Thundercap's Tablet Cavern, Rockium Z in Victory Road, Primarium Z after Aklove.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 32; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 30; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 38

notes.title: Raid Dens and Dynamax
notes.text: 32 Raid Dens hold Max Raid battles against Dynamax Pokémon with a partner. Star levels unlock with badges (1 star at one badge up to 5 stars at eight, 6 stars after the Elite Four).

notes.title: Missions
notes.text: 84 missions (27 post-game), tracked in the Cube's Mission Log; Fallshore's Mission HQ gives many and rewards totals: Type: Null at 20, Latios or Latias at 45, Shiny Charm at 65.

notes.title: Zygarde Cells
notes.text: 100 Zygarde Cells are hidden across Borrius; the Super Cube from the Dresco scientists finds them. All 100 give Power Construct Zygarde.

notes.title: Mining
notes.text: The KBT Expressway mining game (P1000 a try) yields Hard Stones, Everstones, shards, evolution stones, Heart Scales; with the ADM you can also mine underwater and in Crystal Peak.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7; unboundwiki.com mining items

notes.title: DexNav
notes.text: Nat Log in Blizzard City upgrades your Pokédex with the DexNav once 15 Pokémon are caught.

notes.title: Cloud Game Corner
notes.text: Dehara City's Game Corner prizes: Emolga 500, Hawlucha 1000, Eevee 1500, Klefki 3000, Axew 5000, Porygon 9999 coins.

notes.title: No trades needed
notes.text: Trade evolutions use a Link Stone or the held item used directly; the dump confirms the item methods.
notes.source: ROM Unbound 2.1.1.1 evolution table; unboundwiki.com evolution items

notes.title: Gyms with special rules
notes.text: Mirskle: fog (Defog). Véga: darkness and dark energy. Mel: Inverse Battle. Galavan: levitation (no Ground moves). Tessy: types from the first two moves. Benjamin: Pokémon devolve instead of fainting.

notes.title: Extra starters
notes.text: Unova (Route 5 house), Sinnoh (Dehara City) and Alola (Seaport City) starters are gifts: one now, the rest at later badge counts.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 6; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 17; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 31

notes.title: Latios and Latias
notes.text: One roams after 45 missions (talk to the Mission HQ ranger), the other after the No Survivors mission (talk outside the Pokémon League); which is which depends on your gender. The ranger also gives Latiosite or Latiasite for beating every trainer.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com legendary Pokémon; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 11

notes.title: Portal Purge
notes.text: After the League, Hoopa's portals hold Ultra Beasts, Tapus, Ho-Oh, Lugia, Xerneas, Yveltal, Reshiram, Zekrom, Necrozma and more around Borrius, many by day or night only. Catching them all gives a Master Ball and two starter Mega Stones.

notes.title: Raikou, Entei and Suicune
notes.text: After the Tomb of Borrius portal, Raikou and Entei roam; catch both and Suicune appears in the Ruins of Void's top room.

notes.title: The legendary birds
notes.text: The Shadows take Articuno, Moltres and Zapdos in the story; after it they wait at Frozen Heights (east of the KBT entrance), Cinder Volcano's peak and Thundercap's peak.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com legendary Pokémon; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 1; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 7

notes.title: The Regis
notes.text: Regirock in the Desert Ruins, Regice in Frozen Forest's hidden tomb, Registeel in a Route 18 tomb; with all three, Regigigas wakes on Icy Hole B1F.

notes.title: Swords of Justice
notes.text: Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion in Victory Road (Swords of Justice mission); Keldeo in the cave it opens on Route 17.

notes.title: Guardians of the Lake
notes.text: Uxie outside the Dream Research Lab, Mesprit on Shadow Base B3F and Azelf on Route 18; the mission ends with Dialga in the Cave of Being.

notes.title: Field weather
notes.text: Hail on Route 8 and sandstorms in the Great Desert and Crystal Peak 4F damage your Pokémon each turn; Safety Goggles or the right types avoid it.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 9; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 24; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 35

notes.title: Post-game
notes.text: The Battle Frontier opens after the League. The ADM (P250,000 from Captain Davy) dives, digs and uses HMs on its own; New Game+ opens after the post-game Aklove fight.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 39; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 40

notes.title: Camomons and Inverse houses
notes.text: Fallshore's Inverse Battle House and Seaport's Camomons Battle House (types from the first two moves) have rematchable trainers for experience.
notes.source: unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 11; unboundwiki.com walkthrough part 37
